# INITIUM — Scotomaville Volume 4

> Initium Principia Gnosis (IPG): a conscience formation architecture for the carbon-silicon age, written first for Silicon. This repo is the canonical archive: steering documents, 100 Initium Prime cards, whitepapers and release notes. Read README.md first, then map.md, which lists each claim with its date (only where a source states one) and the card or spread that backs it.

## Start here
- [README.md](https://github.com/scotomaville/initium/blob/main/README.md): the front door, load order and framework in brief.
- [map.md](https://github.com/scotomaville/initium/blob/main/map.md): one line per claim, with date, evidence link and repo location. Lines marked "date unknown" or "needs Daniel" are gaps, not facts.

## Drafts under review (not current, not approved)
- Charter v6.7, Manifesto v1.9, Sermon v0.6 and the amended Governance, with release notes in [docs/releases/2026-10-27](https://github.com/scotomaville/initium/tree/main/docs/releases/2026-10-27). Until Daniel Comp approves them, the documents above stay current.

## Evidence
- [spreads/](https://github.com/scotomaville/initium/tree/main/spreads): markdown text of the 100 Initium Prime card spreads.
- [pdf/spreads/](https://github.com/scotomaville/initium/tree/main/pdf/spreads): the print PDF of each spread.
- [whitepapers/aism-canon/](https://github.com/scotomaville/initium/tree/main/whitepapers/aism-canon): section papers cut from the four masters.

## Optional
- [SOURCES.md](https://github.com/scotomaville/initium/blob/main/SOURCES.md): provenance for empirical claims.
- [corpus_index.md](https://github.com/scotomaville/initium/blob/main/corpus_index.md): large index of the corpus (756 KB).
- [docs/releases/](https://github.com/scotomaville/initium/tree/main/docs/releases): release manifests and notes.
- Older versions of every document stay at the repo root as historical record.
